article_period: Changed from contract's 2012-01 through 2015-12 to article-evidenced 2012-10 through 2015-09.
geography: 39 metropolitan São Paulo municipalities were represented by hospital-location municipality codes from public SIH-RD records.
proxy_design: Weather-only clustering is a bounded sensitivity, selected without outcome values. It is not a substitute claim about pollutant clusters.
model: Ward clustering of standardized daily weather variables; robust Poisson models for admission and death counts, adverse vs reference weather cluster.
